name: LX-Family-Planner
description: Private self-hosted family planner with calendars, tasks, shopping, meals, chat, Android notifications, Family Cloud and dedicated child and pet profiles.

paths.name: Family data
paths.description: Persistent database, integration secrets and Firebase configuration.

ports.name: WebUI
ports.description: Port used to open LX Family Planner.

variables.name: Unraid user ID
variables.description: Linux user ID used for files in the appdata folders. Unraid normally uses 99 (nobody).

variables.name: Unraid group ID
variables.description: Linux group ID used for files in the appdata folders. Unraid normally uses 100 (users).

variables.name: App secret
variables.description: Random secret with at least 32 characters. Never change it after the first start.

variables.name: Registration mode
variables.description: Secure default: only the first family can register. Use invite for controlled additional families or open only for an intentional public portal.

variables.name: Registration invite code
variables.description: Required by new families when registration mode is invite. Use a long random value.

variables.name: Public family directory
variables.description: Keep false to prevent family names and profile counts from being visible before login.

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Timezone used for calendar reminders and scheduled tasks.

variables.name: Secure session cookie
variables.description: Automatically uses secure cookies when accessed through HTTPS.

variables.name: Legacy database file
variables.description: Optional path used for a one-time migration from older LX versions.
